_comment: Active milestone goal for supervised autonomy ($pursue). This is a non-claim publication-validation support goal, not a terminal SOTA goal.
goal: Iteratively improve two publication-validation support components for the TE foundation-model project: (A) turn the genome-derived anchor selector into a conservative trust router, and (B) improve TE fragmentation handling via joint structured / interval-aware decoder objectives.
objective: Sustain bounded, single-seed iterations for selector trust routing and structured decoder fragmentation reduction. All outputs are support evidence only; no SOTA claim is allowed from this goal.

screen_anchor._note: This goal is non-claim. Screen comparisons are against these internal safety gates only; screen profile can never claim SOTA.
screen_anchor.source: user-defined conservative router gate for bounded publication-validation support

sota_benchmark._note: Not applicable for this support milestone. This placeholder intentionally prevents SOTA interpretation.
sota_benchmark.source: no published SOTA claim target for this milestone

required_wording.selector: conservative trust router / triage policy, not an exact F1 predictor
required_wording.decoder: prototype or limitation unless segment-F1 and boundary-F1 improve while true-retention guardrails pass

next_iteration_candidates.description: Add genome-wide MinHash/Mash/sourmash or equivalent k-mer distance to anchor prototypes, then rerun leave-species-out and leave-clade-out router validation with abstention/top-k regret gates.
Replace weak token-level retention with interval-level true-retention / fragment-survival objective or segment-aware decoder that penalizes deleting true-backed fragments.

stop_rules.selector: If two consecutive iterations still cannot form a leave-clade abstention/top2 router beyond triage, stop the formula direction and write it as a limitation.
stop_rules.structured_decoder: If two consecutive iterations cannot simultaneously improve segment-F1 and boundary-F1 while controlling missed_true_rate, stop the decoder direction and write it as future work.
